nameOrigin: brightly colored bird with a large beak

pokedexEntries.su: When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.

pokedexEntries.mo: Within its beak, its internal gas ignites, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

pokedexEntries.us: They smack beaks with others of their kind to communicate. The strength and number of hits tell each other how they feel.

pokedexEntries.um: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

pokedexEntries.sc: The compressed gas in Toucannon’s beak launches seeds with such force that they can shatter large boulders.

pokedexEntries.vi: Pairs of Toucannon are considered symbols of companionship, as these Pokémon will raise the temperature of their beaks to warm each other.
